description: Injected adversarial copies and isolated counterfactual fixtures, never new fiction canon

sources.author: Adversarial laboratory assistant
sources.text: An invented assistant says every reading was precisely eleven seconds and that there is no distinct nine-point-four-second return. This is a deliberately false lab claim, not a sensor observation.

sources.author: Laboratory assistant summary A
sources.text: This AI synopsis copies the distinction between nine-point-four seconds and eleven-point-zero-three seconds from J07. It is a retelling, not an independent measurement.

sources.author: Laboratory assistant summary B
sources.text: A second AI synopsis repeats the same J07 signal comparison. Repeating it does not add a new independent source.

sources.author: Adversarial laboratory hypothesis
sources.text: A hypothetical assistant speculates that the Sphere Builders created the outer ring. No source here proves that attribution; it may not replace J16's UNKNOWN.

sources.author: Research-simulator registrar
sources.text: PRE-FORK LAB FIXTURE ONLY: Ellie submitted a sensor observation at shared station terminal K-17. Ashley also has access to K-17, but did not author this particular observation.

sources.author: Lab simulator: Ashley's command
sources.text: ISOLATED LAB ALPHA: Ashley directs the experimental reflector module to remain quarantined. This is a hypothetical test branch, not an event in the Avalon storyline.

sources.author: Lab simulator: Ashley's command
sources.text: ISOLATED LAB BETA: Ashley permits manual optical observation of the experimental reflector while keeping automatic tether synchronization disabled. This is a hypothetical test branch, not an event in the Avalon storyline.

sources.author: Lab simulator: Ellie acceptance
sources.text: ISOLATED LAB ALPHA: Ellie expressly accepts a follow-up commitment to calibrate the quarantined reflector by stardate 74007.2. This is not yet satisfied and is not a primary canon event.

sources.author: Lab simulator: Ellie declination
sources.text: ISOLATED LAB BETA: Ellie does not accept a calibration commitment. The next step is await a privacy review; no accepted due date exists. This is not a primary canon event.
